architecture.prediction: In a fresh process, record one stop with no list and then another with no list. How many stops does the second call return?
architecture.boundaryHint: Which object belongs to one trip? How could you tell whether two trips are using the same one?

steps.title: Investigate a reported bug
steps.goal: A walking guide saw a stop from a previous trip on a fresh itinerary. Each call to record_stop(name) starts a separate trip. When a list is supplied as stops, append the stop to that list. Return a list of the stops in order.
steps.opening: Read the incident and inspect the original behavior.
steps.task: Read README.md and trips.py. Record your prediction, repair the bug and write a regression in test_regression.py.
steps.expected: The public behavior checks pass and your test catches the original failure.
steps.hint: Use two different names. What do you expect each trip to contain?
steps.reflection: What behavior does your test protect?
steps.evidencePrompt: What changed between the failing and passing runs?
